structured_output.title: Internal ACME package refactoring in running cert-manager
structured_output.content: Cert-manager v1.17.0 is installed and actively used in this environment (certificates.cert-manager.io CRD is deployed). The upstream change replaces cert-manager's dependency on `golang.org/x/crypto/acme` with a local fork. Since cert-manager uses the ACME package internally for certificate issuance and renewal, this implementation change will affect the running cert-manager instance during upgrade. Inspect cert-manager logs and ACME provider interactions after upgrade to confirm no unexpected behavior in certificate issuance.
